- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices during negative sentiment (sentiment < -0.10) — add 3–7% to forecast to compensate for downward bias.
- Overshoot after sharp upward spikes — cap forecast at 1–2% below the immediate prior peak.
- Mean-reversion bias: if 3 consecutive forecasts are above 10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 2–5%.
- Lagged overreaction: if sentiment turns negative after a forecast spike, reduce forecast by 3–5% for next 3 periods.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overestimate early in the cycle — adjust downward by 1–3% for first 5 days of forecast horizon.
